caption: Basilica of Santa Croce, Florence
composition: Neo-Gothic polychrome marble facade on Piazza Santa Croce · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands on Piazza Santa Croce before the basilica's neo-Gothic polychrome facade in the bright 12:23 midday sun. White and green marble panels cover the front, the great rose window sits beneath a blue-starred medallion in the gable, and three sculpted portals line the ground floor. The rugged brick campanile rises at the right, plain stone buildings fill the left, and the clear blue sky makes the marble glow.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Santa Croce under morning light
